essence: The earthly goddess is an auspicious bestower of youthfulness.
Worship of this goddess can yield complete freedom from aging and death.
Kaṅkālikā is regarded as the attendant goddess.
This svāhā-ending mantra is to be recited one hundred thousand times.
She bestows that specific boon upon the practitioner of the mantra.
